blocks.heading: How to Prepare
blocks.body:
4 Easy Steps to enjoy Matcha
1 ADD 1 TSP (2g): Add 1 teaspoon (2g) of matcha powder into a bowl.
2 ADD 3 OZ HOT WATER: Pour 3 oz of hot water (175°F / 80°C) into the bowl.
3 MIXING with "W": Whisk in a "W" motion until frothy and smooth.
4 ENJOY MATCHA: Your delicious matcha is ready to enjoy!
